name: OnlySSL Tool
author: onlyssl

sections.description:
OnlySSL Tool allows WordPress site administrators to:
– Enable or disable maintenance mode
– Display a custom message and logo while in maintenance mode
– Add an image URL for visual branding
– Integrate Google Translate for quick multilingual support

This plugin is simple, fast, and secure. Designed for business websites that want an easy way to go into maintenance without third-party services.

External Services

This plugin loads the Google Translate widget from:

  • Service: Google Translate
  • Purpose: To allow users to translate site content into different languages
  • Data Sent: Page content only (no personal data)
  • Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
  • Terms of Service: https://policies.google.com/terms
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/onlyssl-tool/
  2. Activate the plugin from the WordPress Admin dashboard
  3. Go to OnlySSL Tool in your admin menu to configure settings
sections.faq:
Does this plugin collect any data?

No. The plugin does not collect, store, or transmit any personal data.

Does it work with all themes?

Yes, the plugin works with any theme since it’s admin-panel based.

Is it compatible with caching plugins?

Yes, but if you’re using aggressive cache settings, you may need to clear your cache when enabling maintenance mode.
